Same label is general government in the General Fund detail (detail[3]) and in disbursements[0]; treasurer collection fee is not interest. Inconsistent category for the same label.
SID electricity is usually street lighting (streets/highways under the rules); utilities is a judgment call.
Function assigned by judgment (spending listed by object); could be streets/highways or general government. No review flag on statement line.
